quote: It is unlawful for any person to drive a vehicle over any bridge or other elevated structure constituting a part of a highway at a speed which is greater than the maximum speed which can be maintained with safety to the bridge or structure, when such structure is signposted as provided in this section

activation.condition: a person drives over a bridge or elevated highway structure signposted as provided in the section

obligation.description: drive over that structure faster than the Department-determined safe maximum
obligation.source_clause: It is unlawful for any person to drive a vehicle over any bridge or other elevated structure constituting a part of a highway at a speed which is greater than the maximum speed which can be maintained with safety to the bridge or structure, when such structure is signposted as provided in this section

timing.description: while the vehicle occupies the structure

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: maximum speed which can be maintained with safety to the bridge or structure
judgment_calls_needed.note: The Department investigation and declaration are independent administrative sources; authored sign metadata does not establish the safe maximum.

parameter_refs.name: ego_speed
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: observed original Native velocity magnitude during structure occupancy

parameter_refs.name: commanded_approach_speed
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: physical request in m/s, separate from measured speed
